plan.reason: 10D problem with only 24/100 evaluations used but stagnation of 20 and zero recent improvement indicates the current reference design is stalled. Auto surrogate lets held-out RMSE choose between RBF and quadratic as data accumulates. Current_to_best balances convergence toward the surrogate-predicted optimum with DE diversity. Slightly higher exploration (0.35) and modest radius (0.15) spread candidates across normalized space to escape stagnation while local_fraction 0.25 keeps some exploitation. Population 40 and 6 generations give a reasonable candidate pool without over-spending surrogate evaluation; mutation raised to 0.6 for diversity on the stalled run.
